processes.name: Notfallaufnahme, ZNA Manchester-Triage & Voranmeldung
processes.desc: Echtzeit-Notfallzuweisung aus RTW/Feuerwehr über Telemedizin, IVENA-Kapazitätsabgleich und ZNA-Manchester-Triage.
processes.plantUml:
@startuml
title JSD-P-01: Notfallaufnahme, ZNA Manchester-Triage & Voranmeldung
autonumber
skinparam responseMessageBelowArrow true

box "Praehospital & Rettung" #e0f2fe
actor "Rettungsdienst (RTW)" as RTW
participant "[[#sys-JSD-28 JSD-28: Medical IoT Gateway]]" as IoT
end box

box "Telemedizin & Hub" #fef3c7
participant "[[#sys-JSD-05 JSD-05: Telemedizin Hub]]" as TM
participant "[[#sys-JSD-10 JSD-10: HealthShare Hub]]" as HS
end box

box "Akutklinik & Notaufnahme" #dcfce7
participant "[[#sys-JSD-15 JSD-15: ZNA E-Care & Triage]]" as ZNA
participant "[[#sys-JSD-08 JSD-08: CGM MEDICO KIS]]" as KIS
end box

RTW -> IoT: Notfalldaten, EKG & GPS
== [[#integ-JSD-INT-01 JSD-INT-01: Notfall-Voranmeldung RTW ➔ ZNA E-Care]] ==
IoT -> TM: [[#conn-JSD-C-15 RTW-Daten an Telemedizin Hub (MQTT / TLS)]]
TM -> ZNA: [[#conn-JSD-C-16 Voranmeldung an ZNA E-Care (REST FHIR R4)]]
activate ZNA
ZNA -> ZNA: Manchester-Triage Einstufung & Bettenzuweisung

== [[#integ-JSD-INT-02 JSD-INT-02: ZNA Aufnahme ➔ CGM MEDICO KIS Sync]] ==
ZNA -> HS: [[#conn-JSD-C-14 Notfall-ADT an HealthShare (HL7 v2.5 ADT_A04)]]
activate HS
HS -> KIS: [[#conn-JSD-C-01 KIS Fallanlage & Stammdaten (HL7 v2.5 MLLP)]]
activate KIS
KIS --> HS: KIS-Fallnummer Bestaetigung (HL7 ACK)
deactivate KIS
HS --> ZNA: KIS-Fall verknuepft (HL7 ACK)
deactivate HS
deactivate ZNA
@enduml

processes.name: Klinischer Diagnostikpfad & Zentrallabor-Befundung
processes.desc: Order Entry für Laboruntersuchungen aus CGM MEDICO / Martin Luther KIS an Swisslab LIMS mit prioritärer Rückmeldung.
processes.plantUml:
@startuml
title JSD-P-02: Klinischer Diagnostikpfad & Zentrallabor-Befundung
autonumber
skinparam responseMessageBelowArrow true

box "Station & Ambulanz" #e0f2fe
actor "Klinikarzt / Station" as Doc
participant "[[#sys-JSD-08 JSD-08: CGM MEDICO KIS]]" as KIS
participant "[[#sys-JSD-07 JSD-07: Meona Kurve]]" as Meona
end box

box "Klinischer Integrations-Hub" #fef3c7
participant "[[#sys-JSD-10 JSD-10: HealthShare Hub]]" as HS
end box

box "Diagnostik & Zentrallabor" #dcfce7
participant "[[#sys-JSD-11 JSD-11: Swisslab LIMS]]" as LIMS
actor "Laboranalytik (Cobas)" as Analyzer
end box

Doc -> KIS: Laboranforderung erfassen
activate KIS
== [[#integ-JSD-INT-03 JSD-INT-03: KIS Laboranforderung ➔ Swisslab LIMS]] ==
KIS -> HS: [[#conn-JSD-C-01 Labor-Order an HealthShare (HL7 v2.5 ORM_O01)]]
activate HS
HS -> LIMS: [[#conn-JSD-C-03 Labor-Auftrag an Swisslab (HL7 v2.5 MLLP)]]
activate LIMS
deactivate HS
LIMS -> Analyzer: Proben-Scan & Barcode-Routing
Analyzer --> LIMS: Analysenergebnisse & Validierung

== [[#integ-JSD-INT-04 JSD-INT-04: Swisslab Laborbefund-Rueckmeldung]] ==
LIMS -> HS: [[#conn-JSD-C-04 Laborbefund an HealthShare (HL7 v2.5 ORU_R01)]]
activate HS
deactivate LIMS
HS -> KIS: [[#conn-JSD-C-05 Laborbefund-Anzeige im KIS (HL7 ORU)]]
HS -> Meona: [[#conn-JSD-C-13 Laborwerte an Meona eKurve (HL7 / FHIR)]]
deactivate HS
deactivate KIS
@enduml

processes.plantUml:
@startuml
title JSD-P-03: Radiologie DICOM-Workflow, PACS & KI-Diagnostik
autonumber
skinparam responseMessageBelowArrow true

box "Klinische Anforderung" #e0f2fe
participant "[[#sys-JSD-08 JSD-08: CGM MEDICO KIS]]" as KIS
participant "[[#sys-JSD-10 JSD-10: HealthShare Hub]]" as HS
end box

box "Radiologie & Bildarchivierung" #fef3c7
participant "[[#sys-JSD-13 JSD-13: Syngo RIS]]" as RIS
actor "CT / MRT Modalitaet" as Modality
participant "[[#sys-JSD-12 JSD-12: Agfa Enterprise PACS]]" as PACS
end box

box "KI-Cloud & Diagnostik-Support" #fee2e2
participant "[[#sys-JSD-27 JSD-27: Brainomix KI]]" as KI
end box

== [[#integ-JSD-INT-05 JSD-INT-05: Radiologie DICOM-Workflow & PACS]] ==
KIS -> HS: [[#conn-JSD-C-01 Untersuchungsauftrag an HealthShare (HL7 ORM)]]
activate HS
HS -> RIS: [[#conn-JSD-C-07 Anforderung an Syngo RIS (HL7 ORM_O01)]]
activate RIS
deactivate HS
RIS -> Modality: DICOM Modality Worklist (MWL)
Modality -> PACS: DICOM C-STORE Bilddatensatz
RIS -> PACS: [[#conn-JSD-C-08 Worklist & Untersuchungs-Metadaten (HL7 / DICOM)]]
activate PACS

== [[#integ-JSD-INT-06 JSD-INT-06: Agfa PACS ➔ Brainomix Cloud-KI]] ==
PACS -> KI: [[#conn-JSD-C-09 CT-Bilddaten an Brainomix KI (DICOMweb TLS / AWS)]]
activate KI
KI -> KI: Automatisierte e-ASPECTS Schlaganfall-Analyse
KI -> RIS: [[#conn-JSD-C-10 KI-Ergebnis an Syngo RIS (REST FHIR / DICOM SR)]]
deactivate KI
RIS --> KIS: Freigegebener Radiologiebefund (HL7 ORU)

deactivate PACS

activate CPI

activate S4H
